intent_id.description: Exact command intent ID from the candidate list, or 'clarify' when the request is ambiguous.

rationale.description: Brief explanation of why the selected intent best matches the user's request.

needs_clarification.description: True when the request is ambiguous or missing a required detail.

clarification_question.description: One short clarification question, or an empty string when no clarification is needed.

default_model_name.description: Requested workspace default model name, or an empty string when not applicable.

complex_model_name.description: Requested complex/date-extraction model name, or an empty string when not applicable.

channel_model_name.description: Requested per-channel model name, or an empty string when not applicable.

query_text.description: Trailing query text for commands like web search, Notion search, reminder search, or GitHub sync diagnostics; empty when not applicable.

user_mention.description: Explicit Slack user mention required by the chosen command, or an empty string when not applicable.
